map.为什么沿海温差小？: Why Are Coastal Temperature Differences Small?
map.海水比热大，升温降温慢，调节气候；内陆比热小，昼夜/季节温差大。: Seawater has a high specific heat, warming and cooling slowly, which moderates the climate; inland areas have a low specific heat and large day-night and seasonal swings.
